title: smith.toml
description: The configuration of a smith workspace (schema 1). Every setting has a default; a key smith does not know is an error.

schema.description: The smith.toml schema version; smith upgrade migrates older files.

scope.description: npm scope for Node packages, e.g. @acme.

module_prefix.description: Go module path prefix, e.g. github.com/acme/repo.

exclude.description: Workspace-relative globs (examples/**) of directories whose manifests are not projects, in any language.

allowed_outputs.description: Workspace-relative paths a task may write to outside the build directory (dist/), such as a folder a tool embeds (go:embed). smith doctor does not report them. Default: none.

shared_outputs.description: Workspace-relative folders (dist/drop) that several tasks fill on purpose, each with its own files. smith doctor does not report their overlap. Default: none.

registry.description: The [registries] entry the workspace installs from. Default: the public registries.

recipe.description: The recipe new projects are created from: a path relative to smith.toml, or an https URL. smith add --stack bypasses it. Default: none (stacks only).

commit_operations.description: Commit every mutating command (add, remove, upgrade, derive, sync) as one commit when the work tree is clean before it; smith undo reverts the last. Default: false.

defaults.description: The defaults vintage (year.month) the workspace was made with. A newer smith keeps these defaults until smith upgrade --defaults adopts a newer vintage. Default: none (a workspace made before vintages).

attest.description: What the generated GitHub pipeline does about the build provenance attestation of a release's archives: on attests and fails the release job when GitHub refuses (default); optional attests but lets the job go on when GitHub refuses (a private repository of a free organisation has no attestations); off leaves the step out.

secrets.description: Repository secrets the generated pipelines hand to every step that runs smith (the ci job, the native jobs and the assets jobs) as environment variables of the same name, for a build command that reads a token. A name may not start with GITHUB_. Default: none.

devcontainer.description: Write .devcontainer/devcontainer.json with the toolchains CI installs. Default: false.

native_runners.description: Machines the native job runs on, one per OS. Default: ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest.

smith_version.description: The smith the generated pipelines install: latest, or an exact version. Default: the version of the smith that generates them.

native_linux_packages.description: apt packages the native job installs on Linux before building.

branches.description: Branches the generated GitHub and Azure pipelines run on, for pushes and pull requests. The release branch is always included and still the only one a release runs from. Default: the release branch.

azure_pool.description: The agent pool an Azure Pipelines definition runs on (a self-hosted or managed pool's name). Default: Microsoft's hosted ubuntu-latest image.

azure_variable_groups.description: Variable groups of the Library an Azure Pipelines definition links, for the secrets its steps read. Default: none.

audit_policies.description: Ecosystem policy checks smith ci audit runs beyond the vulnerability scan. Default: none.

audit_warn.description: Audit policies that only report instead of failing. Default: none.

audit_allow_install_scripts.description: npm packages whose install scripts the node audit policy accepts. Default: none.

audit_max_unsafe.description: Unsafe blocks the rust audit policy accepts in all Rust sources. Default: 0.

sibling_repos.description: Other GitHub repositories the generated workflow checks out beside the workspace, GitHub Actions only. Default: none.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to check out. Default: the repository's default branch.

env.description: Environment variable that holds the checkout's absolute path in every later step.

dir.description: The checkout's directory in the workspace. Default: the repository's name.

pre_build.description: Shell command run in the checkout before smith sets the workspace up. Default: none.

token_secret.description: GitHub secret holding a token that can read the repository. Default: the job's token.

one_version.description: Report a dependency that projects of one ecosystem declare at different versions, and a dev tool declared outside the root. Default: false (smith new turns it on).

allow.description: Dependencies that may differ between projects: doctor, smith sync and smith deps up --align leave them alone.

presets.description: Packages that carry the team's shared configuration (an ESLint config, a Jest preset): smith up shows their updates first, as one group. Default: none.

boundaries.description: Rules for which projects may depend on which. smith doctor and smith boundaries report each dependency that breaks one; smith ci verify fails on it.

kinds.description: The built-in rule: no project depends on an app. Unset: a warning. true: an error. false: off.

from.description: The projects the rule is about: a name, a glob, kind:app, lang:go or tag:ui.

allow.description: The only projects they may depend on (same names). Empty: no limit.

deny.description: Projects they may not depend on.

reason.description: Why the rule exists; shown with each violation.

exceptions.description: Single dependencies that may stay though a rule forbids them.

from.description: The project that depends (a name, glob, kind:, lang: or tag:).

branch.description: The only branch a real release runs from. Default: main.

remote.description: The remote release tags are pushed to. Default: origin.

github_releases.description: Create a GitHub Release for every tag (needs GITHUB_TOKEN). Default: false.

tag_format.description: The release tag prefix of every project that sets no tag_prefix: {name} is the project's name and {scope} is [workspace] scope, so "{scope}/{name}@" gives @acme/kit@ for kit. Must contain {name}. A prefix a plugin reports (a Go module's <dir>/v) wins. Default: "{name}@".

api_check.description: What smith does when the commits ask for a smaller version bump than the change of a package's public API needs (a removed export needs a major, an added one a minor). warn prints the warning and the bump to use; error stops the release too; off does not look. Only plugins that can list a public API (Node) are checked. Default: warn.

vsce_entra.description: Publish VS Code extensions with Microsoft Entra ID instead of the VSCE_PAT secret: the GitHub workflow signs in to Azure with its OIDC token (workload identity federation) and vsce publishes as that identity. Needs the repository secrets AZURE_CLIENT_ID and AZURE_TENANT_ID, and the app registered as a member of the Marketplace publisher. GitHub Actions only. Default: false.

rubygems_trusted_publishing.description: Publish gems with the GitHub workflow's OIDC token (RubyGems trusted publishing) instead of the GEM_HOST_API_KEY secret. Each gem must be registered as a trusted publisher on rubygems.org first. GitHub Actions only. Default: false.

registry.description: The [registries] entry packages are published to. Default: [workspace] registry, then the public registries.

channels.description: Branches that release a line of prerelease versions of their own, such as 2.0.0-beta.1, 2.0.0-beta.2 from a next branch, whatever versions [release] branch holds. Default: none.

branch.description: The branch the channel releases from. Not [release] branch, and not the branch of another channel.

prerelease.description: The prerelease identifier of the channel's versions, such as beta or rc.

major.description: The major version of the channel's line. The first release is <major>.0.0-<prerelease>.1.

dist_tag.description: The name the channel publishes under (npm's dist-tag), which keeps latest where it is. Default: the prerelease identifier.

enabled.description: Keep the MonoSmith agent files (.claude/agents/smith.md, .mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json). false says they are absent on purpose: smith doctor and smith upgrade leave them alone. Default: true.

dir.description: The task cache directory, workspace-relative or absolute. Default: .smith/cache.

max_size_mb.description: Keep the local cache under this size: after a run that stored results, the least recently used entries past it are removed. 0 means no limit. Default: 2048.

remote.description: A shared cache behind the local one: https://host/path, s3://bucket/prefix or azblob://account/container/prefix. Objects are signed with SMITH_CACHE_KEY; one that fails verification is a miss.

remote_read_only.description: Read the remote cache without writing to it (SMITH_CACHE_READ_ONLY=1 does the same). Default: false.

derive.description: Derived files: files smith writes from facts and the project graph, with an ownership record in smith.lock. Off by default.

enabled.description: Turn derived files on: smith derive works, smith doctor reports drift and smith ci verify runs smith derive --check. Default: false.

facts.description: Shared facts every project gets: typed values under namespaced keys that plugins read when they set a project up. They win over the defaults plugins publish and lose to [projects.<name>.facts]. smith explain <project> --facts shows each value and where it came from.

module.aliases.description: Import aliases and the project-relative directory each stands for, such as { "@app" = "src" }. The TypeScript, Jest, Vite and Vitest plugins write them into the project's configs.

source.roots.description: Project-relative directories that hold source code.

test.patterns.description: Globs that select test files, relative to the project.

runtime.node.description: The Node.js version range the project runs on.

toolchains.description: Runtime versions the workspace builds with, by toolchain label (node, go, python, rustc, java, dotnet, ruby, php, dart, cmake). A version is a prefix: "22" accepts any 22.x. smith doctor reports a machine on another version.

enabled.description: Built-in language plugins to load. Default: all of them.

marketplace.description: The plugin index smith plugin search and smith plugin install <name> read: an https URL or a file path. SMITH_MARKETPLACE overrides it. Default: the index of github.com/monosmith-app/plugins.

external.description: Plugins outside the smith binary, by name; one replaces a built-in plugin of the same name.

command.description: The executable and its arguments. Empty: find it installed on the plugin search path.

env.description: Environment variables the plugin may see beyond the baseline smith gives every external plugin: names, or prefixes ending in * (AWS_*). Adds to what the plugin's own plugin.json declares.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the plugin's file. In CI an external plugin starts only when this matches. smith plugin trust <name> --pin writes it.

conventions.description: Plugins applied to every project of the languages they support, by name.

languages.description: Narrow the convention to some of the languages it supports.

registry.description: Docker only: where release pushes the apps' images (ghcr.io/acme). Unset: images are built, never pushed. ghcr.io logs in with GITHUB_TOKEN, docker.io with DOCKERHUB_USERNAME and DOCKERHUB_TOKEN, another registry with CONTAINER_USERNAME and CONTAINER_PASSWORD. For several registries use registries.

description_from.description: Docker only: a workspace-relative file (README.md) whose text becomes the repository description on Docker Hub after a release.

short_description.description: Docker only: the one-line summary shown under the image's name on Docker Hub (100 characters at most; longer is cut at a word). Default: the project's own description.

tag_commit.description: Docker only: also tag every image sha-<short commit>, the tag deployment platforms and GitOps agents follow. Default: false.

tag_branch.description: Docker only: also tag every image with the release branch's name (main). Default: false.

push.description: Docker only: false builds images without pushing them on release. Default: true when a registry is set.

verify.description: Docker only: false stops smith ci verify building the affected apps' images on pull requests. Default: true (an app without Docker on its runner is skipped with a warning).

stacks.description: Stacks declared here, by name: the plugins a project is built with.

choices.description: The stack as a saved selection of choices (smith choices lists them). smith derives the language, the scaffold and the toolchain from them and adds the default of an axis a choice needs; toolchain, structure and deploy add plugins after those.

language.description: The language plugin that discovers the stack's projects. With choices it is derived.

toolchain.description: Toolchain plugins, in order: a later one may replace a task an earlier one added.

scaffold.description: The plugin that generates new projects; empty: the language plugin.

default_stacks.description: The stack of a project that records none, and of smith add without --stack, by language plugin.

recipes.description: The recipe for one project kind (app, lib or package), instead of [workspace] recipe.

tasks.description: Overrides of a task for every project, by task name.

task_groups.description: Task overrides for the projects a group selects, between [tasks.<task>] and [projects.<name>.tasks.<task>]. With several groups matching, a later one wins field by field.

select.description: Selectors; a project must match all of them: a name, a glob, kind:<app|lib|package>, lang:<language> or tag:<tag>.

tasks.description: Overrides by task name, with the fields of [tasks.<task>].

projects.description: Settings of one project, by project name.

root.description: Declares a project at this workspace-relative folder when it has no manifest of its own (a program or a library that is a package of the Go module above it). Needs language.

language.description: The language of a declared project (go): the plugin that describes it. Needs root.

kind.description: The kind of a declared project. Default: an app when the folder holds a program, else a lib.

bare_tags.description: Tag releases with the bare version (0.1.0) instead of <name>@0.1.0, for a registry that uses the tag name as the version (JitPack). Only one project can; it excludes tag_prefix.

tag_prefix.description: Replaces the release tag prefix (<name>@ by default).

stack.description: Replaces the stack the project's manifest records.

tags.description: Tags added to the ones the project's plugin reports, for [boundaries] rules and --projects tag:<tag>.

schemas.description: Workspace-relative globs of shared schema files (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protocol Buffers, GraphQL) the project owns, besides those inside its directory.

consumes_schemas.description: Workspace-relative globs of schema files the project consumes: it depends on their owner, so a schema change affects it.

generate.description: Code generated from a shared schema: a generate task that runs before the project's build, cached on the schema's content.

schema.description: Workspace-relative schema file (OpenAPI or Protocol Buffers). The project consumes it.

generator.description: What to generate: the openapi-generator name (go, typescript-fetch) or the protoc plugin (go, python).

version.description: Pins the generator tool; a new version regenerates.

out.description: Output directory, relative to the project. Default: generated.

command.description: Replaces the default command; {schema}, {schema_dir}, {out} and {generator} are replaced.

docker.description: The app's settings for the docker convention.

image.description: The image's name under the registry. Default: the project's name, lowercase.

registry.description: Where release pushes this app's image, instead of the convention's registry or registries.

description_from.description: A workspace-relative file whose text becomes this app's Docker Hub repository description.

short_description.description: This app's one-line Docker Hub summary (100 characters at most), instead of the convention's or the project's description.

tag_commit.description: Also tag this app's image sha-<short commit>, instead of the convention's setting.

tag_branch.description: Also tag this app's image with the release branch's name, instead of the convention's setting.

push.description: false builds the image but never pushes it on release.

verify.description: false stops smith ci verify building this app's image on pull requests.

context.description: The build context, workspace-relative: "." (the workspace, the default) or a directory such as the app's own, for a Dockerfile written for it (Nx's: docker build apps/api).

split_repo.description: A GitHub repository (owner/repo) each release is mirrored to: the project's directory split out, pushed to its main branch and tagged vX.Y.Z, for a registry that reads a package at a repository root (Packagist). Needs SPLIT_REPO_TOKEN.

registry.description: The [registries] entry this package is published to, instead of [release] registry.

facts.description: Shared facts for this project, the narrowest scope: they win over [facts] and over the defaults plugins publish. Same keys as [facts].

settings.description: Plugins' settings for this project, by plugin name: what a recipe's settings became when it created the project. A plugin reads its own table.

recipe.description: The recipe the project was created from, written by smith add: enough to resolve the same recipe again with the same answers.

version.description: The recipe's version when the project was created.

source.description: The recipe as [workspace] recipe named it: a path or a URL.

answers.description: The recipe's choices as they were answered, by choice name.

release.description: Makes an app releasable: versioned by its tag, its assets built and attached.

asset_name.description: Asset file name pattern; placeholders {product}, {version}, {os}, {arch}, {ext}. With build the files are renamed on upload and the placeholders are {product}, {version}, {platform}, {ext}.

checksums.description: With build, attach a SHA-256 checksums file of the files each runner uploads.

build.description: A shell command, run at the workspace root on one runner per platform, that makes the files assets names. They are uploaded to the GitHub Release with gh release upload (never an artifact), whatever the language. The command sees SMITH_PLATFORM, SMITH_VERSION and SMITH_TAG. Needs [release] github_releases, assets and platforms (a Tauri app's plugin supplies all three); excludes os_alias, arch_alias, version_variable, package_managers, linux_packages, npm, pypi, nuget, rubygems and pub.

assets.description: Workspace-relative globs of the files build leaves, each uploaded to the release. Needs build (a Tauri app's plugin supplies both).

platforms.description: os/arch pairs; with build, runner names: windows-x64, macos-arm64, macos-x64, linux-x64, linux-arm64.

version_variable.description: The symbol the version is stamped into. Default for Go: main.version.

package_managers.description: Manifests generated from the assets and attached to the GitHub Release.

linux_packages.description: Linux packages built from the linux archives (binary in /usr/bin) and attached to the GitHub Release.

npm.description: npm packages the app is published as; the first also names the per-platform packages (<first>-<os>-<cpu>). Needs NODE_AUTH_TOKEN.

pypi.description: PyPI project the app is published as, one wheel per platform. Needs PYPI_TOKEN.

nuget.description: .NET tool package the app is published as (dotnet tool install -g <name>), with one <name>.<rid> package per platform. Needs NUGET_API_KEY.

rubygems.description: Gem the app is published as, one platform gem per platform. Needs GEM_HOST_API_KEY.

pub.description: pub.dev package the app is published as (dart pub global activate <name>), holding every platform's binary. Published from GitHub Actions by the generated pub workflow, through pub.dev's automated publishing.

channels.description: false keeps the project out of the release channels: on a channel branch it is neither planned nor published (for example a Go module whose path lacks the /v2 the channel's major needs). Default: true.

pub_tag.description: The tag pub.dev's automated publishing matches, with {name} (the release tag prefix without its @) and {version}. Default: {name}-v{version}.

description.description: What the app is, for the package manager manifests.

homepage.description: The app's homepage. Default: the GitHub repository.

license.description: An SPDX license identifier, e.g. MIT.

registries.description: Private package registries by name: Azure Artifacts, GitHub Packages or any token-protected registry.

auth.description: azure-artifacts: the pipeline's own token through Azure's authenticate tasks; github-packages: GITHUB_TOKEN; token: the variable token_env names.

token_env.description: The environment variable holding the token, for auth = "token".

pypi.description: The simple index pip installs from (.../simple/).

pypi_upload.description: Where twine uploads. Default: pypi with /simple/ replaced by /upload/.

maven.description: The Maven repository packages deploy to: an https URL, or "github" for GitHub Packages (https://maven.pkg.github.com/<owner>/<repo> of the repository the release runs in; needs auth = github-packages).

dockerRegistries.description: Docker only: the registries release pushes the apps' images to, each under the same name and tags. A "host/namespace" string uses the host's credentials (ghcr.io: GITHUB_TOKEN with packages: write; docker.io: DOCKERHUB_USERNAME and DOCKERHUB_TOKEN; another host: CONTAINER_USERNAME and CONTAINER_PASSWORD, for one only). A table names the variables: { url, username_env, password_env }. Instead of registry, never with it.

task.description: Replaces individual fields of a plugin-inferred task; unset fields keep the plugin's value.

command.description: argv, run without a shell; {workspaceRoot}, {projectRoot} and {smith} are expanded.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory (. is the root).

inputs.description: Globs relative to the project; {workspaceRoot}/... for root files; ! excludes.

outputs.description: Directories restored on a cache hit.

verify.description: Run the task in smith ci verify on pull requests, for affected projects. An app's package task does by default; false turns that off.

serve.description: A task (web:start, or start in the same project) smith starts before this one and stops after it, whatever the result: the app an end-to-end suite tests.

serve_url.description: Waited for (HTTP 2xx) before the task starts, and passed to it as E2E_BASE_URL.

serve_timeout.description: How long to wait for serve_url (60s by default).
